reviewPolicy: Every user-facing medical, urgent-help, service-route or privacy claim must be checked here before public campaign launch. Source verification is not the same as medical review.

claims.pageOrComponent: Urgent help module: index.html, play.html, prep-pep.html, after-sex.html, testing-sti.html, services.html
claims.claimHr: Ako postoji neposredna opasnost, ozljeda, prisila ili hitna medicinska situacija, nazovi 112 ili 194.
claims.claimEn: If there is immediate danger, injury, coercion, or an urgent medical situation, call 112 or 194 in Croatia.
claims.notes: Official source lists 112 as the unified emergency number and 194 for emergency medical service.

claims.claimHr: Ako misliš da ti možda treba PEP, potraži medicinsku pomoć što prije. PEP je vremenski osjetljiv i liječnik procjenjuje je li indiciran.
claims.claimEn: If you think you may need PEP, seek medical help as soon as possible. PEP is time-sensitive and a doctor assesses whether it is indicated.
claims.sourceName: Klinika za infektivne bolesti "Dr. Fran Mihaljević" - PEP information
claims.notes: Croatian source states to seek medical help immediately after possible exposure and that a doctor assesses risk and PEP introduction.

claims.claimHr: PEP je vremenski osjetljiv: potražite stručnu pomoć što prije, idealno unutar 24 sata, a najkasnije unutar 72 sata nakon mogućeg izlaganja.
claims.claimEn: PEP is time-sensitive: seek professional help as soon as possible, ideally within 24 hours and no later than 72 hours after possible exposure.
claims.sourceName: WHO - Guidelines for HIV post-exposure prophylaxis
claims.notes: WHO overview describes timely access as crucial and states ideally within 24 hours and no later than 72 hours.

claims.claimHr: PEP nije proizvod koji se samostalno uzima u ljekarni.
claims.claimEn: PEP is not a pharmacy self-service product.
claims.sourceName: Klinika za infektivne bolesti "Dr. Fran Mihaljević" - PEP information
claims.notes: The site uses this as a safety framing to avoid implying casual purchase or independent use. Confirm exact Croatian phrasing with medical reviewer.

claims.claimHr: PEP može smanjiti mogućnost infekcije HIV-om ako se započne na vrijeme nakon stručne procjene i uzima prema uputama. Nije jamstvo.
claims.claimEn: PEP can reduce the chance of HIV infection when started in time after professional assessment and taken as prescribed. It is not guaranteed.
claims.notes: Prototype wording avoids guarantees. Medical reviewer should confirm final public wording.

claims.claimHr: PrEP je planirana prevencija HIV-a prije mogućeg izlaganja. Zahtijeva testiranje na HIV, liječničku procjenu, recept i praćenje. PrEP štiti od HIV-a, ne od drugih spolno prenosivih infekcija.
claims.claimEn: PrEP is planned HIV prevention before possible exposure. It requires HIV testing, medical assessment, prescription, and follow-up. PrEP protects against HIV, not against other STIs.
claims.notes: CDC states PrEP is HIV prevention for people without HIV and baseline assessment/HIV testing is required before prescribing.

claims.claimHr: U centrima za HIV savjetovanje i testiranje u Hrvatskoj može se anonimno i besplatno testirati na HIV i dobiti individualan savjet stručnjaka.
claims.claimEn: Croatian HIV counseling and testing centers can provide anonymous and free HIV testing and individual professional counseling.
claims.sourceName: HZJZ - Gdje se u Hrvatskoj može savjetovati i testirati
claims.notes: Individual services still need direct verification before public launch.

claims.claimHr: Period prozora i potreba za ponavljanjem ovise o testu i situaciji; savjetovalište ili zdravstveni djelatnik trebaju pomoći s odabirom vremena testiranja.
claims.claimEn: Window periods and repeat testing depend on the test and situation; a counseling service or healthcare provider should help choose timing.
claims.notes: General safe framing only; no test-specific timing is given in the prototype.

claims.claimHr: Klinika za infektivne bolesti "Dr. Fran Mihaljević" objavljuje informacije o savjetovanju/testiranju na HIV, hepatitise i sifilis te o PEP-u.
claims.claimEn: The "Dr. Fran Mihaljević" infectious diseases clinic publishes information about HIV/hepatitis/syphilis counseling/testing and PEP.
claims.sourceName: Klinika za infektivne bolesti "Dr. Fran Mihaljević"
claims.notes: Operational details can change; service entry is shown as needs-verification before visit.

claims.claimHr: CheckPoint Zagreb je stvarna HUHIV usluga za testiranje/savjetovanje; ova stranica nije službena stranica HUHIV-a ili CheckPointa Zagreb.
claims.claimEn: CheckPoint Zagreb is a real HUHIV testing/counseling service; this site is not the official HUHIV or CheckPoint Zagreb website.
claims.notes: Naming and affiliation review required before public campaign launch.

claims.claimHr: Ova statička stranica nema račune, obrasce, analitiku ni namjerno prikupljanje zdravstvenih podataka; jezik i napredak priče ostaju u pregledniku.
claims.claimEn: This static site has no accounts, forms, analytics or intentional health-data collection; language and story progress stay in the browser.
claims.notes: Legal/privacy review still required before adding any form, analytics, petition platform or third-party embed.
